summary.title: Flutter 3.10.0 Master Class for Beginners to Advanced | Ticket Booking App Development Tutorial
summary.one_liner: A long video course that walks through building a Flutter ticket booking app from project setup to a finished multi-screen UI, using the Flutter 3.10.0 toolkit.
takeaways: How a Flutter project is structured, including main.dart as the entry point and how setState works
Building a bottom navigation bar with a stateful BottomBar widget and multiple screens
Laying out UI with Row, Column, Container, Stack, and Expanded widgets
Adding image assets and the Get and gap dependencies via pubspec.yaml
Building ticket-style cards and a profile screen, with scrolling and tabs
summary.summary: This is a YouTube video (about 6.5 hours, 39 lessons) from the dbestech channel titled as a Flutter 3.10.0 master class for beginners to advanced. The course builds a ticket booking app step by step, with chapters covering project creation, the main.dart entry point, setState, the MaterialApp and Scaffold widgets, and bottom navigation. Later sections cover layout widgets, asset and dependency setup in pubspec.yaml, a ticket view with custom shapes and a barcode, a search screen with hotel and ticket tabs, and a profile screen. The page text is mostly the chapter list and transcript index, so the full detail of the code is not visible here.
